quotes.text: … what I think we can do is actually come together on reducing the number of unplanned pregnancies and the number of abortions, because if we treat this issue as a public health problem and not a culture war problem, then we can actually make progress together. … If we can join together to make sure that we have scientifically valid sex education, age-appropriate sex education, if we can make sure that folks who need contraception can get it, if we can make sure everyone has health care, … then we know that that reduces the number of abortions.
quotes.editor_note: FLAG, needs a human decision: this does not directly answer the legal-framework question, since he says he and the voter reach different conclusions on legality and then proposes reducing abortions through sex education, contraception, and health care. Two cuts marked with … (his complaint about how the debate is argued, and an aside about the Catholic Church), and the leading … marks that he started with 'but'.
